entries.title: 1 Chronicles 6:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The priest's office - So did all the rest, but it is implied that he did it worthily, he filled his place, and valiantly discharged his office in Uzziah's time. Solomon built - In Solomon's temple; so called to distinguish it from the second temple which was built or in building when these books were written.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 6:44
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Ethan - Called also Jeduthun, chap. 9:16 2Chron 35:15, and in the titles of divers psalms.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 6:54
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Castles - So called, not only because, walled and well guarded by the country; but because they and their possessions were in a particular manner the care of divine providence. As God was their portion, so God was their protector. And a cottage will be a castle to those that abide under the shadow of the Almighty. The lot - Or, the first lot.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 6:66
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Coasts - Or, of their borders, of their country contained within its borders.
